# Asset licenses

Every non-code asset in this repo, and where it came from.

## 3D vehicle models (`public/models/*.glb`)

**Original placeholder geometry, generated by `scripts/generate-placeholder-models.mjs`.**
Simple boxes and cylinders (not a real car brand, model, or logo), built
programmatically with [`@gltf-transform/core`](https://gltf-transform.dev/)
to prove out the 3D-card pipeline (status badge, fuel/charge gauge,
recoloring by the material named `body`) end to end. License: CC0 / public
domain -- these are our own generated geometry, free to use, modify, or
replace.

**These are intentionally plain placeholders.** Swap in real, licensed
low-poly vehicle models when available: drop the replacement `.glb` into
`public/models/` under the same filename (`sedan.glb`, `hatchback.glb`,
`suv.glb`, `van.glb`, `pickup.glb`, `motorcycle.glb`), keep a material
literally named `body` so recoloring keeps working, and add an entry here
with the source and license.

## Fonts

Source Sans 3 and Source Serif 4, loaded via `next/font/google` in
`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx`. Both are
[SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/OFL), served and
self-hosted by Next.js's font optimization (no runtime request to Google
Fonts).
